series.name: E0 (single aggregator page) — not on PK official table
series.notes: E0 not on official PK master table; HDU E0 meanings differ (drain/power). Do not merge.

meaning.en: E0 flags indoor temperature sensor failure, frequently associated with low incoming voltage or EEPROM/PCB faults.
meaning.ur: E0 indoor temperature sensor ki kharabi batata hai, jo aksar incoming power ki low voltage ya EEPROM/PCB fault se juri hoti hai

causes.en: Incoming power issues (low voltage or excessive consumption)
causes.ur: Incoming power ke masile (low voltage ya zyada consumption)

causes.en: EEPROM parameter or indoor PCB configuration fault
causes.ur: EEPROM parameter ya indoor PCB configuration kharabi

solutions.en: DIY: power off, wait 5–10 minutes for capacitors to discharge, then restart
solutions.ur: Khud karam: band karein, capacitors discharge hone ke liye 5–10 minute intezaar karke on karein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect PCB and EEPROM connections
solutions.ur: technician: PCB aur EEPROM connection check kre

source.title: Appliance Code Hub Haier E0 page

notes.en: Only non-soft-404 E0 page found on that site. E0 not on official PK table; HDU E0 meanings (drain/power) differ — do not merge. confidence medium per single structured source.
